verse.verse_1: By the fig, and the olive,
verse.verse_3: And by this city of security (Makkah).
verse.verse_4: Verily, We created man of the best stature (mould),
verse.verse_5: Then We reduced him to the lowest of the low,
verse.verse_6: Save those who believe (in Islamic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds, then they shall have a reward without end (Paradise).
verse.verse_7: Then what (or who) causes you (O disbelievers) to deny the Recompense (i.e. Day of Resurrection)?
verse.verse_8: Is not Allah the Best of judges?
